descs: Long fields, tithe-lane to tithe-lane, grain country under a wide gray sky.

spots.name: The Tithe-Post
spots.desc: A waist-high post at a field corner, its carved measure worn but legible: the standard sack, chalked and re-chalked every autumn since before anyone here was born. Nobody has adjusted it in living memory.
spots.brief: The tithe-post, its carved measure.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 2 south and 3 east. The Hunger Barn: 4 south.

spots.name: The North Lane's Foot
spots.desc: The tithe-lane widens here where cart-traffic from the Vale first meets the open fields, ruts cut deep enough to catch a boot. North, the lane climbs on toward the Vale of Ash.
spots.brief: The lane's foot. North: the Vale road.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 2 south and 2 east. The Hunger Barn: 4 south and 1 west.

spots.name: Cart-Rut Rise
spots.desc: The ground rises just enough to dry the ruts here before anywhere else, so every tithe-cart for a hundred years has chosen this exact line. The grass between the ruts has never once recovered.
spots.brief: Rising ground, deep old cart-ruts.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 2 south and 1 east. The Hunger Barn: 4 south and 2 west.

spots.name: Lookout Rise
spots.desc: A low rise at the fields' northern edge, worn stone footings the only sign anything once stood watch here. North, a broken tower still keeps a little of its height above the grain.
spots.brief: A rise. North: a broken watch-tower.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 2 south. The Hunger Barn: 4 south and 3 west.

spots.name: The Boundary Hedge
spots.desc: A hedgerow taller than a rider marks the region's western edge, laid and kept for longer than the fields themselves have had a name. Nothing about it invites a way through.
spots.brief: A tall, unbroken boundary hedge.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 south and 4 east. The Hunger Barn: 3 south and 1 east.

spots.name: Empty Gleaning
spots.desc: A strip left for gleaners by old custom, picked clean every year down to the last dropped ear. It is picked clean now too, though nobody has walked it since dawn.
spots.brief: A gleaning-strip, already picked clean.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 south and 3 east. The Hunger Barn: 3 south.

spots.name: The Cross-Furrow
spots.desc: Two furrows meet here at a crook no plow would choose on purpose, as if the field itself remembers a boundary that predates the plowing. Nothing grows quite right along the seam.
spots.brief: Furrows meeting at an old, crooked seam.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 south and 2 east. The Hunger Barn: 3 south and 1 west.

spots.name: The Hedge Gap
spots.desc: A gap worked into the hedge here, too neat to be an accident of weather, too well-used to be a secret from anyone who actually looks. Boot-marks and drag-lines cross it going both ways, none of them chalked on any tally board.
spots.brief: A worked gap in the hedge, well-used.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 south and 1 east. The Hunger Barn: 3 south and 2 west.

actions.label: read the gap's marks
fx: Boot-marks going out heavier than coming back, a drag-line for sacks, and a second, fainter set that doubles on itself — someone counting their own steps out of habit. You know this gap now.

spots.name: Sixmile Stone
spots.desc: A worn marker gives the distance to Marrowgate in a hand nobody uses for measuring anymore. Six miles, it still claims, though the road it once measured has long since wandered off elsewhere.
spots.brief: An old, wandering distance-stone.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 south. The Hunger Barn: 3 south and 3 west.

spots.name: Sheaf Rise
spots.desc: The fields climb gently toward the region's eastern edge, the ground here never quite as productive as the rest, kept anyway out of some old habit. East, a chapel roof breaks the grain.
spots.brief: Rising ground. East: a chapel roof.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 south and 1 west. The Hunger Barn: 3 south and 4 west.

spots.name: Hedge's End
spots.desc: The boundary hedge finally breaks here, worn thin by one household's determined, decades-long refusal to walk any further around it than necessary. West, past the gap, a hut sits low against the hedge-line.
spots.brief: The hedge breaks. West: a low hut.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 4 east. The Hunger Barn: 2 south and 1 east.

spots.name: The Fallow Strip
spots.desc: A strip left unplanted every year since the Winter of Locked Doors, by nobody's order that anyone can now name — just a habit nobody has ever quite dared to break. Weeds have made a kind of peace with it.
spots.brief: A strip left fallow since that winter.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 3 east. The Hunger Barn: 2 south.

spots.name: Milldam Reach
spots.desc: The stream widens above the millrace, slowed by a low dam of old, black-stained timber. Water pools dark and patient behind it, no hurry at all to reach the wheel it's meant to turn.
spots.brief: Dark water, pooled above the millrace.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 east. The Hunger Barn: 2 south and 2 west.

spots.name: Tithing's Edge
spots.desc: The fields give way to hard-packed ground and the first low roofs of Tithing itself, granary thatch showing gray-gold above a lane worn to bare earth leading straight in to the market cross.
spots.brief: The fields' edge. In: the village proper.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is here. The Hunger Barn: 2 south and 3 west.

spots.name: East Furlong
spots.desc: A long, straight furlong runs the region's eastern edge, better tended than most ground this far from the village, though nobody you've met yet has claimed it as theirs.
spots.brief: A long, well-tended furlong.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 west. The Hunger Barn: 2 south and 4 west.

spots.name: The Widow's Croft
spots.desc: One croft still worked past the boundary hedge, a woman turning soil that owes her nothing and gets it anyway. A Crown surveyor's chalk mark, fresh, is scrawled across her gatepost.
spots.brief: A worked croft. A fresh Crown chalk-mark.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 north and 4 east. The Hunger Barn: 1 south and 1 east.

spots.name: The Gallows Oak
spots.desc: A single blasted oak stands alone mid-field, one bare limb still bearing the groove of an old rope, cut generations before the Hunger Barn's own beam ever took its turn at the same office.
spots.brief: A blasted oak, an old rope-groove.
onEnterOnce: Nailed into the bark, gone soft with rot: the remains of a Crown notice, a debt and a name too weathered to read whole.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 north and 3 east. The Hunger Barn: 1 south.

spots.name: The Millpond
spots.desc: Black, still water backs up behind the mill's own sluice, deep enough to lose a dropped tool and never see it again. Something about the stillness makes people walk the long way round instead.
spots.brief: The millpond, black and still.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 north and 2 east. The Hunger Barn: 1 south and 1 west.

spots.name: Long Acre
spots.desc: A long, unbroken run of grain, tended well enough that it's easy to forget, standing in the middle of it, that the ground under your boots once went a whole winter without a single hand to work it.
spots.brief: A long, well-tended run of grain.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 north. The Hunger Barn: 1 south and 3 west.

spots.name: The East Hedge
spots.desc: A second boundary hedge, lower and younger than the western one, marking where the Hearthlands' claimed fields simply stop and somebody else's country begins.
spots.brief: A lower, younger boundary hedge.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 1 north and 1 west. The Hunger Barn: 1 south and 4 west.

spots.name: The Fallen Croft
spots.desc: A croft with its roof gone to the weather and its door standing open on nothing, one of a dozen the winter emptied and nobody has since had the heart, or the hands, to take back.
spots.brief: A fallen croft, its roof long gone.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 2 north and 4 east. The Hunger Barn: 1 east.

spots.name: The Barn Track
spots.desc: A cart-track runs straight in from the fields here, grass grown up through the ruts but the line of it still plain. It leads to a barn nobody in Tithing much likes to name out loud.
spots.brief: A cart-track. In: an old barn.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 2 north and 3 east. The Hunger Barn: here.

spots.name: Sump Field
spots.desc: The ground turns soft and dark here, water standing in every low place no matter the season. A twist of something dried and bundled has been left wedged under a stone, oddly deliberate.
spots.brief: Soft, waterlogged ground.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 2 north and 2 east. The Hunger Barn: 1 west.

spots.name: Long Field South
spots.desc: More grain, more furrows, the fields running on long enough here that it's easy to lose count of which strip belongs to which household, if any of them still do.
spots.brief: More long, unbroken fields.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 2 north and 1 east. The Hunger Barn: 2 west.

spots.name: Sack Road
spots.desc: A packed-earth track breaks off from the main fields here, wagon-ruts pressed deeper than any honest cart-traffic would leave them, dipping toward a stand of scrub where tents show through the branches.
spots.brief: A worn track, dipping toward a camp.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 2 north. The Hunger Barn: 3 west.

spots.name: The Southeast Hedge
spots.desc: The younger hedge bends south here, thinner and more recently laid, as if whoever kept it ran short of both time and conviction before finishing the job properly.
spots.brief: A thin, hastily-kept hedge.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 2 north and 1 west. The Hunger Barn: 4 west.

spots.name: The South Rise
spots.desc: A low rise gives the best view south of anywhere in the fields, salt-smell already faint on the wind if the day is right. The ground beyond it starts sloping toward the coast in earnest.
spots.brief: Rising ground. A hint of salt on the wind.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 3 north and 3 east. The Hunger Barn: 1 north.

spots.name: Fallow Verge South
spots.desc: The fields thin toward the region's southern edge, grain giving way by degrees to scrub and salt-tolerant grass that no tithe has ever bothered counting.
spots.brief: Thinning fields, salt-grass beyond.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 3 north and 2 east. The Hunger Barn: 1 north and 1 west.

spots.name: The South Lane's Foot
spots.desc: The tithe-lane gathers itself here for the last stretch south, ruts running straight and true toward salt air and open cliff-country beyond the fields.
spots.brief: The lane's foot. South: the coast road.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 3 north and 1 east. The Hunger Barn: 1 north and 2 west.

spots.name: The Last Furlong
spots.desc: The southernmost furlong the Hearthlands still claims, grain giving out entirely a few dozen paces past it into country the tithe-lanes were never cut to reach.
spots.brief: The southernmost furlong.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: From here, Tithing is 3 north. The Hunger Barn: 1 north and 3 west.

onEnter: Something gray and stoop-backed straightens up out of the furrows ahead, hands still moving through the motions of a harvest that finished four hundred years ago.

vars.NAME: Saint Garner's Chapel
vars.SIGN: An empty grain-scoop hangs by the door, tapping like something asking to be filled.

vars.NAME: the Tithe-Lookout
vars.VIEW: the tithe-lanes cross the fields like a chalked tally, Tithing's granary roof the only bright thing for miles
vars.SIGN: A chalk-board still hangs at the base, its columns rain-streaked past any reading.

vars.NAME: the Hedge-Hermit's Hut
vars.SIGN: Snares hang along the wall, more than one person could tend, each carefully empty.
vars.LOOT: a twist of good seed, kept back from forty tithes running
vars.VOICE: Doesn't blink first. Doesn't much blink at all, if he can help it.

vars.NAME: the Sack Road Camp
vars.SIGN: Sacks are stacked and counted in neat rows, every one of them chalked with a mark that isn't the Crown's.
vars.LOOT: a runner's oilskin tally, half of it in a hand nobody in Tithing would recognize

hl_threshing_flail.name: a threshing flail
hl_threshing_flail.hint: farm tool, and a plain enough weapon at need

hl_dried_peas.name: a twist of dried peas
hl_dried_peas.hint: keeps for a season — eat it to ease a wound

fx: Hard going down dry, but they sit well enough, and the ache eases before you've finished the twist.

hl_gleaner.name: hollow gleaner
hl_gleaner.desc: Gray to the bone and thin past any hunger a living body could survive, still working a harvest that was never going to be brought in.
onDeath: It folds down into the furrow it was working and doesn't get up again, its hands finally still.
